cases.sentence: Иоанн носил одежду из верблюжьей шерсти и подпоясывался ___.
cases.explain: «кожаным поясом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

cases.sentence: В то время из ___ Назарета пришел Иисус и тоже был крещен Иоанном в Иордане.
cases.explain: «галилейского города» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

cases.sentence: Иисус был там один, в окружении ___, и ангелы служили Ему.
cases.explain: «диких зверей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

cases.sentence: Однажды, проходя вдоль ___, Иисус увидел Симона и его брата Андрея.
cases.explain: «Галилейского моря» — after the preposition «вдоль», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

cases.sentence: Как раз в это время в синагоге находился человек, одержимый ___, который вдруг закричал:
cases.explain: «нечистым духом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

cases.sentence: ___ сотряс человека и с громким криком вышел из него.
cases.explain: «Нечистый дух» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

cases.sentence: Нечистый дух сотряс человека и с ___ вышел из него.
cases.explain: «громким криком» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

cases.sentence: В тот день Иисус исцелил многих от самых ___ и изгнал много демонов.
cases.explain: «различных болезней» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

cases.sentence: По рассвету, Симон и ___ бросились искать Его 37 и, когда нашли, сказали Ему:
cases.explain: «другие ученики» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

cases.sentence: Из-за этого Иисусу стало невозможно открыто появляться в городе, и Он оставался в ___.
cases.explain: «безлюдных местах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.
